selection: Freeze one policy and risk fraction before the requested start, using only cash flows released before September6 from orders decided before September1 (five-day settlement buffer). Rank by mean daily log cost-basis equity growth minus a simultaneous bootstrap maximum-statistic uncertainty penalty across all4608 policy-size-cost streams (2304 policy-size pairs). Require a strictly positive costed bound with nonzero bootstrap variance, >=60 release days, positive stress profit and no unresolved position at cutoff in either scenario. Otherwise hold cash. This is a retrospective development selector; reused earlier data cannot confer independent validity.
objective: Maximize the pre-period uncertainty-adjusted log-growth criterion within the fixed candidate set, subject to the goal's capital limits; never select using the requested year's ending bankroll.
fees: Explicit historical sensitivity assumption, not verified contemporaneous fees. Aggregate integer order notional and quadratic fee are rounded against the account to cents; no per-contract P&L scaling.
execution: Candle endpoints have neither contemporaneous receipt nor depth proof. Hypothetical mode caps each order at100 contracts, freezes quantity/limit before later prices, and rejects missing endpoints. This arbitrary capacity ceiling is a sensitivity assumption, not historical liquidity. Verified mode must refuse unproven availability/depth.
calendar_coverage: Score only the existing unsealed daily-market panel through September30,2025. Annual ending trading bankroll must be null until the entire requested calendar is acquired and evaluated under a separately frozen continuation. Missing months are never silently imputed as no-trade days. Cash-only baseline for the whole365days is200 with zero interest, zero external cash flows and no trading fees.
holdout: October-December2025 stays sealed. This registration does not authorize reading protected prices/outcomes. No alteration of config/validation.json or promotion gates.
reporting: Retain every candidate, selected cash/trade result, excluded orders, reserved cash, open principal, cost-basis versus zero-mark equity, integer quantities, fees and missing calendar dates. No probability-of-ruin or100x target forecast from an unvalidated edge.
